description.value: A family-oriented, music-free campground on 28 acres of coastal rainforest near Squamish, with maintained riverside trails, a general store, and clean flush washrooms with pay showers; tent sites run $55/night, making it one of the pricier private options in the Sea to Sky corridor.

address.value: 3520 Paradise Valley Road, Squamish, BC V0N 1T0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong primary evidence. The front page, FAQ, rates page, and guest reviews collectively confirm contact details, seasonal operation, potable water, pay showers, an on-site general store with ice and propane refills, online booking, and electrical outlets in the washroom (confirmed by a 2025 guest review citing the outlet near the office). No hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discount, laundry, or dedicated animal-safe food storage are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or address; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.

Front page still displays 2023 seasonal dates ('OPEN APRIL 28, 2023 THRU OCTOBER 1, 2023'), suggesting website content is not fully refreshed each season, though multiple 2025 guest reviews confirm the campground is actively operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established seasonal campground in Squamish with strong amenities relevant to touring cyclists (potable water, showers, on-site food and propane, device charging, online booking) and consistently high guest ratings; a clear fit for the Sea to Sky corridor directory.

wow_evidence: general store, and clean flush washrooms with pay showers
